item.title: [翻译] Construction Physics: 本周阅读清单 06/06/26
item.description:
标签: #房地产 #制造业 #基础设施 #AI

摘要: 本周阅读清单汇总了建筑、基础设施与工业科技领域的热点文章，涵盖AI聊天机器人替代理房产经纪人卖房、中国合成钻石应用于AI芯片散热、佛罗里达州酝酿取消大部分房产税，以及伦敦摩天大楼通过设置公共屋顶平台获取规划许可等话题。此外，清单还涉及伊朗局势、AI引发生物安全风险，以及3D打印机和半导体制造相关的科技政策动态。

原标题: Reading List 06/06/26

Reading List 06/06/26

Welcome to the reading list, a weekly roundup of news and links related to buildings, infrastructure and industrial technology. This week we look at chatbots replacing realtors, Chinese synthetic diamonds, Australian batteries, Meta's data center tents, and more. Roughly 2/3rds of the reading list is paywalled, so for full access become a paid subscriber.

欢迎来到阅读清单，这是关于建筑、基础设施（infrastructure）和工业技术的每周新闻与链接汇总。本周我们将探讨聊天机器人（chatbots）取代房地产经纪人、中国人造钻石、澳大利亚电池、Meta的数据中心帐篷等话题。阅读清单中约有三分之二的内容设有付费墙，如需完整访问请成为付费订阅者。

Iran war

Iran breaks off negotiations with the US and vows to "completely block" the Strait of Hormuz. [CNBC]

伊朗中断与美国的谈判，并发誓要"完全封锁"霍尔木兹海峡（Strait of Hormuz）。[CNBC]

Analysis of satellite data by the BBC suggests the damage Iran has inflicted on US military facilities is more extensive than has been previously reported. [BBC]

BBC对卫星数据（satellite data）的分析表明，伊朗对美国军事设施造成的破坏比以往报道的更为严重。[BBC]

Housing

A NYT reporter successfully uses an AI chatbot instead of a realtor to sell their house. "A flurry of bookings to view our house over the coming weekend arrived in my inbox within hours. I struggled to manage the appointments until, again, I just let the chatbot do everything for me. I told agents that they had to email or text — no phone calls. Whatever they wrote, I copied and pasted into the chatbot; whatever it replied, I copied and pasted right back to the agents. I was worried that pushy ones would prey on my inexperience, so I had the chatbot come up with a list of potential conflicts and write confident responses I could have ready." [NYT]

《纽约时报》一位记者成功地使用AI聊天机器人（AI chatbot）而非房地产经纪人（realtor）来出售自己的房屋。"在接下来的周末，大量看房预约在几小时内涌入我的收件箱。我疲于应付这些预约，直到后来干脆让聊天机器人包办一切。我告诉中介必须通过邮件或短信联系——不接受电话。他们写了什么，我就复制粘贴到聊天机器人里；它回复了什么，我就直接复制粘贴回给中介。我担心那些强势的中介会利用我的经验不足，于是让聊天机器人列出潜在的冲突点，并撰写好自信的回复供我备用。"[NYT]

Opposition to property taxes is having a political moment, which as we've mentioned previously is aprettybad idea. Now Florida really seems like it might be on the verge of effectively eliminating homeowner property taxes. "Gov. Ron DeSantis' property tax plan for the November ballot would raise the homestead exemption to $250,000 and require the Legislature to enact a plan to eliminate property taxes entirely for the vast majority of Floridians who own the homes they live in, he announced Wednesday DeSantis said he was calling the Legislature back to Tallahassee on Monday to add an amendment to the ballot that would eventually eliminate property taxes for 92% of those Floridians by raising the homestead exemption to $500,000." [Governing]

反对财产税（property taxes）的呼声正迎来一个政治风口，正如我们此前提到的，这是一个相当糟糕的主意。如今佛罗里达州似乎真的处于有效取消房主财产税的边缘。"罗恩·德桑蒂斯（Ron DeSantis）州长周三宣布，他针对11月选票推出的财产税计划将把宅地豁免额（homestead exemption）提高到25万美元，并要求州议会制定一项计划，为绝大多数拥有自住房的佛罗里达人完全取消财产税。德桑蒂斯表示，他将于周一召集州议会回到塔拉哈西，在选票上增加一项修正案，通过将宅地豁免额提高到50万美元，最终为92%的佛罗里达人取消财产税。"[Governing]

The urban benefits of allowing tall buildings. "Land-use regulations, including height limits, affect housing affordability and urban productivity. This column analyses over 11,000 urban agglomerations and 300,000 tall buildings to explore the effect of height restrictions on welfare. Vertical growth enhances land efficiency, reduces commuting, and boosts worker welfare. While higher density can increase housing demand and rents, the associated gains more than offset the costs." [VoxEU]

允许建造高层建筑的都市效益。"包括高度限制（height limits）在内的土地利用法规会影响住房可负担性和城市生产力。本专栏分析了超过11,000个城市群（urban agglomerations）和300,000栋高层建筑，以探讨高度限制对福利的影响。垂直发展（vertical growth）提高了土地利用效率，减少了通勤时间，并提升了劳动者福利。虽然更高的密度可能增加住房需求和租金，但由此带来的收益远超成本。"[VoxEU]

It's apparently easier to get planning permission to build a skyscraper in London (a city which has notoriously made it almost impossible to build new housing) if you include a publicly accessible roof deck, and thus quite a few London skyscrapers have them. [Diamond Geezer]

显然，在伦敦（这座以几乎不可能建造新住房而臭名昭著的城市），如果你设计一个可供公众进入的屋顶露台，获得建造摩天大楼（skyscraper）的规划许可（planning permission）会更容易，因此伦敦不少摩天大楼都设有此类设施。[Diamond Geezer]

A census map of where air conditioning is uncommon in the US. [X]

一张显示美国哪些地区空调（air conditioning）不普及的人口普查地图。[X]

Manufacturing

As AI gets more capable, the risk that someone uses it to design an engineered virus or pathogen rises. To help mitigate this risk, IFP co-led an open letter calling for mandatory record-keeping of who has purchased synthetic nucleic acids and the equipment for making them. "As life sciences researchers, builders of AI and biotechnology, and experts with a wide range of views on how to approach AI policy, we call on legislators to make screening of orders for synthetic nucleic acids — and the equipment needed to make them — mandatory." [ScreenDNA.org]

随着AI能力日益增强，有人利用其设计工程化病毒（engineered virus）或病原体的风险也在上升。为帮助降低这一风险，IFP联合发起了一封公开信，呼吁对购买合成核酸（synthetic nucleic acids）及其合成设备的人员进行强制性记录保存。"作为生命科学研究人员、AI与生物技术建设者，以及在AI政策上持有广泛观点的专家，我们呼吁立法者强制要求对合成核酸订单——以及制造它们所需的设备——进行筛查。"[ScreenDNA.org]

One surprising beneficiary of the AI boom: Chinese manufacturers of synthetic diamonds, which are used as part of cooling systems for semiconductors. "Traditionally associated with jewelry, these synthetic gems are now being adopted as chip‑cooling materials, enabling denser and more powerful AI semiconductors. Momentum has accelerated after several Chinese producers reported that clients validated their diamonds as effective heat spreaders and began commercial shipments." [Bloomberg]

AI热潮的一个意外受益者：中国人造钻石制造商，其产品被用作半导体（semiconductors）冷却系统的一部分。"这些合成钻石（synthetic diamonds）传统上与珠宝相关联，如今正被采纳为芯片冷却材料，使密度更高、性能更强的AI半导体成为可能。在几家中国生产商报告客户已验证其钻石为有效的散热片（heat spreaders）并开始商业发货后，这一势头进一步加速。"[Bloomberg]

California passes a bill requiring 3D printers to include controls to block the production of "ghost guns." [The Register]

加利福尼亚州通过一项法案，要求3D打印机（3D printers）内置控制机制，以阻止"幽灵枪"（ghost guns）的生产。[The Register]

Elon Musk's "Terafab" semiconductor fab gets a big tax break from a Texas county. [KBTX]

埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）的"Terafab"半导体工厂（semiconductor fab）从德克萨斯州一县获得了大幅税收减免（tax break）。[KBTX]

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: OpenAI 锁定模式：防御数据外泄的确定性方案
item.description:
标签: #数据外泄 #提示注入 #大模型 #安全

摘要: OpenAI推出"锁定模式"（Lockdown Mode），通过限制出站网络请求来阻断提示词注入攻击中的数据外泄环节。这一确定性防护机制虽会牺牲部分功能，但能为面临高风险的用户提供更可靠的安全保障。

原标题: OpenAI Help: Lockdown Mode

OpenAI Help: Lockdown Mode

OpenAI 帮助文档：锁定模式（Lockdown Mode）

Lockdown Mode is designed to help prevent the final stage of data exfiltration from a prompt injection attack by limiting outbound network requests that could transfer sensitive data to an attacker. Lockdown Mode does not prevent prompt injections from appearing in the content ChatGPT processes. For example, a prompt injection could appear in cached web content or in an uploaded file, and could still affect the behavior or accuracy of a response.

锁定模式（Lockdown Mode）旨在通过限制可能将敏感数据传输给攻击者的出站网络请求，帮助防止提示词注入（prompt injection）攻击最后阶段的数据外泄。锁定模式并不能阻止提示词注入出现在 ChatGPT 处理的内容中。例如，提示词注入可能出现在缓存的网页内容或上传的文件中，并且仍然可能影响回复的行为或准确性。

Lockdown Mode is designed to help prevent the final stage of data exfiltration from a prompt injection attack by limiting outbound network requests that could transfer sensitive data to an attacker. Lockdown Mode does not prevent prompt injections from appearing in the content ChatGPT processes. For example, a prompt injection could appear in cached web content or in an uploaded file, and could still affect the behavior or accuracy of a response.

锁定模式（Lockdown Mode）旨在通过限制可能将敏感数据传输给攻击者的出站网络请求，帮助防止提示词注入（prompt injection）攻击最后阶段的数据外泄。锁定模式并不能阻止提示词注入出现在 ChatGPT 处理的内容中。例如，提示词注入可能出现在缓存的网页内容或上传的文件中，并且仍然可能影响回复的行为或准确性。

This looks really good to me.

在我看来，这非常不错。

TheLethal Trifectaoccurs when an LLM system has access to all three of access to private data, exposure to untrusted content and a way to steal data and transmit it back to the attacker.

当 LLM 系统同时满足三个条件时——能够访问私人数据、暴露于不受信任的内容，以及存在窃取数据并将其传回给攻击者的途径——致命三重威胁（Lethal Trifecta）就会发生。

The only way to solve the trifecta is to cut off one of the three legs, and by far the easiest leg to restrict without making your LLM systems far less useful is the exfiltration vectors to steal data.

解决这一三重威胁（trifecta）的唯一方法是切断三条腿中的一条，而迄今为止，在不让 LLM 系统大幅降低实用性的前提下，最容易限制的便是用于窃取数据的外泄向量（exfiltration vectors）。

It looks to me like lockdown mode directly attacks that leg, using mechanisms that are deterministic and, crucially, are not evaluated by AI systems that themselves can be subverted by sufficiently devious attacks.

在我看来，锁定模式（lockdown mode）直接针对这条腿发起攻击，它所采用的机制是确定性的，且关键的是，这些机制不会由 AI 系统进行评估——而这些系统本身就可能被足够狡猾的攻击所颠覆。

The existence of lockdown mode does however imply that ChatGPT, in its default settings, doesnotprovide robust protection against sufficiently determined data exfiltration attacks!

然而，锁定模式（lockdown mode）的存在恰恰意味着，在默认设置下，ChatGPT 并不能为抵御决心足够的数据外泄（data exfiltration）攻击提供强有力的保护！

Update:This tweetOpenAI CISO Dane Stuckey:

更新：这条推文来自 OpenAI 首席信息安全官（CISO）Dane Stuckey：

Lockdown mode is not meant for everyone. However, for folks who have an elevated risk profile - due to who they are, what they work on, or the types of data they work with - it's an excellent tool for further securing themselves. This has some tradeoffs on functionality and utility, but for these users, the tradeoff is worthwhile.

锁定模式并非面向所有用户。然而，对于那些因自身身份、工作内容或所处理数据类型而具有较高风险特征（elevated risk profile）的人来说，这是一个进一步保护自身安全的绝佳工具。这在功能和实用性上会有一些权衡（tradeoffs），但对这些用户而言，这种权衡是值得的。

However, for folks who have an elevated risk profile - due to who they are, what they work on, or the types of data they work with - it's an excellent tool for further securing themselves. This has some tradeoffs on functionality and utility, but for these users, the tradeoff is worthwhile.

锁定模式并非面向所有用户。然而，对于那些因自身身份、工作内容或所处理数据类型而具有较高风险特征（elevated risk profile）的人来说，这是一个进一步保护自身安全的绝佳工具。这在功能和实用性上会有一些权衡（tradeoffs），但对这些用户而言，这种权衡是值得的。
